name: Strong Customer Authentication 2
definition: EU PSD2 Strong Consumer Authentication data.

SubjectToSCA.name: Subject To SCA
SubjectToSCA.definition: Boolean flag indicating whether the transaction is subject to Strong Customer Authentication requirements (True) or not (False).

DelegatedAuthority.name: Delegated Authority
DelegatedAuthority.definition: Authentication performed by a delegated authority (for example by a wallet solution).

Waiver.name: Waiver
Waiver.definition: Waiver claimed for a transaction subject to Strong Customer Authentication.

ReasonAuthenticationNotPerformed.name: Reason Authentication Not Performed
ReasonAuthenticationNotPerformed.definition: Reason why authentication was not performed.
